newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks narrowly mixed in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks narrowly mixed in London.

text.p: Japanese shares were narrowly mixed in London on Monday is slow trading, dealers said.
At 1531 GMT, the Nikkei 50 index was up 7.87 to 1,410.49.
Dealers said there was virtually no interest in the shares that had led the Nikkei 225 share index up 129.86 points to 18,053.50 in Tokyo.
They linked the upward push to the rise in the dollar, which lost much of its steam during European trading hours.
"We got no follow through on the issues that moved overnight," said one dealer.
He noted light bargain hunting in the securities sector in the wake of the Nomura Securities Co Ltd scandal.
"It's all very thin volume though," he said. "I'd expect a flat day in Tokyo tomorrow."
